questions.stem: According to the text, what role does Saharan dust play in the Amazon?
questions.subject: READING_WRITING
questions.passage: Nutrients in Amazonian soil are washed out almost as fast as decay releases them, which makes the forest's productivity a long-standing puzzle. Part of the answer arrives from an unlikely direction. Dust lifted from a dried lake bed in Chad crosses the Atlantic every year, and the phosphorus it carries settles over the basin. Satellite estimates put the annual delivery at roughly the quantity the rivers carry away.

choices.content: It supplies most of the nitrogen the basin's trees require.

choices.label: B
choices.content: It settles into the rivers and is eventually carried out to sea.

choices.label: C
choices.content: It replaces phosphorus that is washed out of the basin's soil.

choices.label: D
choices.content: It reduces rainfall over the basin by scattering incoming sunlight.

questions.passage: The high-yielding wheat varieties introduced across South Asia in the 1960s roughly doubled harvests within a decade. They also depended on irrigation and on fertiliser bought each season, neither of which the smallest holdings could reliably afford. In several districts the gap in income between large and small farms widened as the new seed spread. The gains in output were real, and so was the unevenness in who collected them.

choices.label: A
choices.content: The income gap between large and small farms grew wider.

choices.label: B
choices.content: Harvests on the smallest farms fell below their earlier levels.

choices.label: C
choices.content: Fertiliser became cheaper as more farmers began to buy it.

choices.label: D

The method delivers this precision only where a master sequence already exists for the species and region in question, which is why it has transformed the archaeology of the American Southwest and barely touched that of the humid tropics.

choices.content: To describe a dating method and identify the condition that limits where it can be used.

choices.label: B

choices.label: C
choices.content: To explain why trees in the humid tropics grow without visible rings.

choices.label: D
choices.content: To recount how tree-ring dating was first discovered.

Radiocarbon dates from the site made the assumption untenable.

choices.label: B

Historians use it constantly and qualify it constantly.
